## What's here, and what's coming

The [team ratings](/cbb/tools/team-ratings.html) are the first basketball page. They come from a model that forecasts each game's margin, total, and winner, and its [method and testing](/cbb/tools/team-ratings.html#method) are on the same page. Every day's forecasts are recorded before tip-off so they can be graded in public later. Team pages and a page grading those forecasts are next.

Definitions for the terms used across the site are in the [glossary](/glossary.html), and longer explainers are on the [Learn page](/learn/).

::: {.note}
Data provided by [CollegeBasketballData.com](https://collegebasketballdata.com).
:::
